title: Jahmyr Gibbs "for sure" trying to break LaDainian Tomlinson's single-season TD record

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs "for sure" trying to break LaDainian Tomlinson's single-season TD record
sources.description: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs scored a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 45-24 win over the Cardinals and that pushed him ahead of a Lions legend for the most touchdowns before the age of 25 in NFL history.
